text:
Aisha: FYI customer reported provisional tokens > confirmed after a streaming reconnect + toolcall retry. Sending sanitized trace.

Tom: paste the ids?

Aisha: trace (sanitized): req=cli-83a2, events=[start, chunk104, chunk120, disconnect, resume(s=s-1931), chunk80, toolcall(start,id=rc-7), toolcall(truncate), retry(toolcall,id=rc-7-retry), end], provisional=304, confirmed=188

Ravi: sounds like truncated toolcall from first session was credited then retry credited again. Router fallback lost origin_session mapping.

Sasha: we've seen this in canary. Router handoff emits truncated_toolcall but ledger treats it as chargeable terminal fragment; retry gets charged again.

Tom: backend idea: only convert provisional->confirmed when we see canonical ack (session_confirm or stream_eof) for origin_session_id. Also add provisional flag on events.

Ravi: agree; add toolcall_attempt_id and finalized flag. Also provisional TTL (suggest 2m) to auto-expire if no confirm arrives.

Sasha: impl note: router currently drops origin_session_id on handoff due to types mismatch. I'll add a small shim to pass it through (1-2d).

deploy-bot: deploy/canary finished infra/router-shim (e3b9f2) :white_check_mark:

Aisha: short-term UX: console show per-route "Tentative" badge with hover: "Includes provisional charges pending final ack 	61-5 min". Reduces Ops panic.

Tom: add integration test for connect->disconnect->resume->retry and a debug log when origin_session_id is dropped: origin_session_dropped=true req=...

Ravi: I'll write an RFD for ledger dedupe rule and telemetry schema change. Hold refunds policy until we collect telemetry.

Sasha: I'll post UX mocks (per-route badge + per-request token timeline).

Aisha: TL;DR: preserve origin_session_id, emit provisional + attempt ids, provisional TTL, console badge. Follow-ups assigned. Thanks!
